about_short_description.short_description: Wibmo is a payment technology company that offers digital payment solutions and online payment processing services.

product.name: Accosa IVS
product.description: A payment authentication platform that integrates AI and ML to analyze transaction data and detect anomalies in real time for secure payment processing.

product.name: Trident FRM
product.description: A machine learning-based fraud detection and prevention engine that assesses risk and detects fraudulent transactions in real time across multiple channels.

product.name: Tridentity
product.description: A multifactor out-of-band authentication solution that provides secure, passwordless payment authentication by analyzing user behavior and detecting anomalies.

product.name: Video KYC
product.description: A video-based customer identification service that enables faster, paperless KYC by verifying identity through live video interaction and geotagging.

product.name: Token Hub
product.description: A multi-network, multi-issuer tokenization service that secures payment data by replacing sensitive information with tokens across various payment networks.

product.name: BankEzy
product.description: A cloud-native, API-ready digital banking platform that offers a 'bank in a box' solution for financial institutions to launch digital financial services quickly.
